summary: Add opt-in Swift collection-v1 membership paging and complete page/stream joining

compatibility.detail: Additive Swift APIs require collection-v1 metadata and an epoch; legacy APIs remain unchanged. No capability is advertised or consumer activated.

manual.detail: No upgrade action required; consumers must explicitly opt in and subscribe before loading pages.

recovery.detail: No database recovery changes; typed restart errors discard the entire paging attempt.
